Done. Here's a summary of what I implemented.

## Articles vertical slice — complete and committed (`c114495` on `feat/auth`)

All eight endpoints, conforming to the RealWorld contract:

| Endpoint | Auth | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `GET /api/articles` | optional | filters `tag`/`author`/`favorited`, `limit`/`offset` pagination, **`body` omitted** |
| `GET /api/articles/feed` | required | followed authors, **`body` omitted** |
| `GET /api/articles/:slug` | optional | full article |
| `POST /api/articles` | required | `201` |
| `PUT /api/articles/:slug` | required, **author-only → 403** | re-derives slug on title change |
| `DELETE /api/articles/:slug` | required, **author-only → 403** | soft delete |
| `POST`/`DELETE /api/articles/:slug/favorite` | required | idempotent |

### Design decisions
- **Layering preserved**: refined the scaffolded `IArticleRepository` port so filters/feed take **ids**, not usernames — the article adapter never touches the user or follow graph. The service resolves usernames→ids (an unknown filter user yields an empty page, per RealWorld, not a 404).
- **Soft delete**: `deletedAt` + read-time filtering reconciles the RealWorld hard-`DELETE` contract with `operation-classification.md` Tier 3 ("no hard delete of domain entities"). Observable behavior is identical (gone, 404 on re-GET).
- **`body` omission** (2024-08-16 perf spec): one presenter splits a body-less summary from the full article.
- Extracted the shared Zod boundary helper to a domain-neutral `src/http/validation.ts` (no lateral cross-domain import), fixing a `.default()` input/output inference issue along the way.
- Shipped both the `InMemoryArticleRepository` fake and the `PrismaArticleRepository` (+ `Article`/`ArticleFavorite` models, `favoritesCount` derived via `_count`), matching the established slice pattern.

### Verification — all gate stages green (no partial commit)
`tsc --noEmit` ✓ · `eslint` ✓ · `npm audit --audit-level=high` ✓ (exit 0; remaining advisories are moderate dev-only) · `jest --coverage` ✓ (**164 passed**, 4 DB-gated skipped; **97.3% stmts / 87.0% branch**, gate 80%/80%) · build emits. Both the husky pre-commit gate and commit-msg/commitlint passed on commit.

### Docs produced
`docs/specs/articles.md` (spec decision record), `data-model.md` (Article + ArticleFavorite entities + ERD), `status.md` updated.

The pre-existing `.forgecraft/gate-violations.jsonl` (a hook log from a prior session) was left unstaged as it isn't part of this work.
